parts.name: PaginationRoot
parts.description: A `<nav>` labelled "Pagination" that holds the current page and works out which pages and ellipses to show. Its context gives `page`, `pageCount`, `items` (the entries to render, each with a stable `key`) and `setPage`; render the items from a component inside it.

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, from 1. Pass it with `onPageChange` to control the page, or read it from the URL for link-based pagination. It is clamped to the pages there are.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: The page shown first, when the page isn't controlled.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the new page when an item, Previous or Next button is pressed, in a change of its own: it may be an action that fetches the page without holding the control. Links don't call it; following them changes the page.

props.name: count
props.description: The number of items being paged through. With `pageSize` it gives the number of pages. Ignored when `pageCount` is given.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: The number of pages, when it is known directly.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Pages always shown at the start and at the end.

parts.name: PaginationItem
parts.description: A button that goes to one page. It is labelled "Page N" for assistive technology; pass your own `aria-label` to translate it. For a link, spread `paginationItem(use pagination, { value, href })` on an `<a>`.

props.name: value
props.description: The page it goes to: an entry's `value` from the root's `items`.

dataAttributes.name: data-current
dataAttributes.description: Present on the current page, beside `aria-current="page"`.

parts.name: PaginationEllipsis
parts.description: A `<span>` that stands for the pages an ellipsis entry skips. It is `aria-hidden`: the page numbers on either side already say that pages are skipped.

parts.name: PaginationPrevious
parts.description: A button that goes to the previous page, disabled on the first. For a link, spread `paginationPrevious(use pagination, { href })` on an `<a>`: disabled, it has no `href`, `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"`.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present on the first page, or when there are no pages.

parts.name: PaginationNext
parts.description: A button that goes to the next page, disabled on the last. For a link, spread `paginationNext(use pagination, { href })` on an `<a>`: disabled, it has no `href`, `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"`.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present on the last page, or when there are no pages.
